curriculum: 上海幼儿园启蒙 + 沪教牛津小学 + 牛津阅读树对话
source: 小学目录参考沪教牛津版(六三制)；牛津阅读树为 Biff/Chip/Kipper 家庭原创短句（每行≤10词），非 ORT 教材原文。
note: 牛津阅读树用书里角色名 Mum/Dad/Floppy；句式原创。三年级起 8 单元/册，一二年级 12 单元/册。

g5_up.title: Unit 10 · Wind
g5_up.text:
Wind blows the kites.
Strong wind moves trees.
Gentle wind feels cool.
Wind can be helpful.
Nature has power.

g5_up.title: Unit 11 · Water
g5_up.text:
Water is important.
We should save water.
Turn off the tap.
Plants need water too.
Do not waste water.

g5_up.title: Unit 12 · Fire
g5_up.text:
Fire can be dangerous.
Do not play with matches.
Call adults for help.
Learn fire safety rules.
Stay safe always.

g5_down.title: Unit 1 · Tidy up!
g5_down.text:
Tidy up your room.
Put toys in the box.
Fold your clothes.
A clean room feels nice.
Let's tidy up now!

g5_down.title: Unit 2 · Our new home
g5_down.text:
We move to a new home.
My room is bigger.
We unpack the boxes.
Neighbours say hello.
Welcome to our home.

g5_down.title: Unit 3 · In the future
g5_down.text:
In the future I will travel.
Robots may help us.
Study English well.
Keep healthy habits.
Plan for tomorrow.

g5_down.title: Unit 4 · Reading is fun
g5_down.text:
Reading is fun.
Books open new worlds.
Read a little daily.
Libraries are quiet.
Stories teach us much.

g5_down.title: Unit 5 · At the weekend
g5_down.text:
At the weekend I rest.
We visit the museum.
Sometimes I play sports.
Homework comes first.
Enjoy your weekend.

g5_down.title: Unit 7 · Open day
g5_down.text:
School open day is coming.
Parents visit our class.
We show our projects.
Teachers greet families.
We feel proud today.

g5_down.title: Unit 8 · Buying clothes
g5_down.text:
I am buying clothes.
This shirt fits me.
May I try size small?
Blue looks good on me.
Thank you, assistant.

g5_down.title: Unit 9 · Seeing the doctor
g5_down.text:
I do not feel well.
I have a sore throat.
The doctor helps me.
Take medicine on time.
Rest and drink water.

g5_down.title: Unit 10 · Great inventions
g5_down.text:
Great inventions change life.
The wheel helps transport.
Phones connect people.
Think like an inventor.
Ideas can improve life.

g5_down.title: Unit 11 · Chinese festivals
g5_down.text:
Chinese festivals are special.
Spring Festival is important.
We eat dumplings together.
Mid-Autumn has mooncakes.
Festivals bring families close.

g5_down.title: Unit 12 · The giant's garden
g5_down.text:
The giant's garden story.
Spring comes to the garden.
Children play happily.
Sharing brings joy.
Kindness wins at last.
